descriptions.d27h_input_event_800a6c80: Raw input event: kind 0 stores the mouse scale values, adds the deltas to +100 and +104, multiplies by 320 and 240, sets the moved flag and flushes pending messages when the runtime allows; kinds 2 and 3 update items of kind 5 for the button and send range and entry-name messages (kind 2 also sends a press message first); kind 4 sends wheel direction messages and the wheel amount to items of kind 4.
